cycle: UPSC CSE Prelims 2026 GS Paper I
data_provenance: UPSC CSE Prelims GS Paper I official pattern: 100 Q / 200 marks / 2 hours; +2 / −⅔ (0.66). Per-area question counts are planning estimates from multi-year PYQ trends (not official UPSC section quotas — GS Paper I has no fixed sectional cut-offs). CSAT (Paper II) is qualifying-only and out of scope for this bank.
important_caveat: Paper I (GS) is merit-deciding for Prelims. Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying (33%) and excluded from this MCQ bank. Area counts in all_subjects_table are planning weights for the paper wizard, not mandated sectional sizes.

exam_day.note: GS Paper I (2h) morning; CSAT Paper II (2h) afternoon — CSAT out of scope here.

Paper_1.label: UPSC CSE Prelims GS Paper I
Paper_1.overall_difficulty: Statement-heavy GS; mix of recall and analytical elimination

section_1_single_correct.note: UPSC Prelims GS Paper I is 4-option single-correct MCQ only (includes statement-based, match, assertion-reason formats presented as MCQ).

marking.note: Negative marking is one-third of the marks assigned to the question (⅔ mark).

question_types_note: UPSC CSE Prelims GS Paper I uses only 4-option single-correct MCQ. Statement-based, match-the-following, and assertion-reason appear as MCQ stems, not separate machine-scored types.
